hypothesis: A frozen instruction model may recognize a new span resembling a donor in ways a single embedding misses. Test whether giving it the correct correspondence between donor evidence and the winning skill changes a policy's real return. This is a terminal span controller. The reader and both actual writers remain frozen.
data: Use all seven pre-existing verified rule-2 witnesses from sessions 1-4 of the six training histories. Drop every witness from the target history. Present each remaining masked donor question, up to 24 words from its first annotated evidence turn inside the donor span and the winning skill. The target exposes only its current conversation, up to 12 evenly spaced turns truncated to 20 words each, with consistent anonymous speakers. No target benchmark question, future turn, retrieved answer, or target return enters any prompt.
trial: Before scoring, register all prompt texts and hashes for 12 factorial terminal spans in sessions 5-8 (91 questions) and all 25 randomized terminal-pivot spans starting at session 9+ (209 questions). Keep both actual prefixes under the native root distribution for the factorial panel and the assigned prefix for the randomized panel. Use the original reader and writer scores including questions with evidence outside the focal span. Report each panel separately. A prospective later window requires all six numerical votes before either observed path's first scores. Existing branch scores at prompt registration are disclosed separately.
actor: Run greedy Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct on GPU 7 for two opposite option orders under each of three donor treatments: verified, cyclically permuted winner labels preserving their histogram, and no demonstrations. Rotate the sorted donor label sequence by one position. Accept only response A or B with optional final punctuation; map invalid responses to zero. Each order casts +1 for activity, -1 for temporal. Average both orders. Add clip(empty + verified - permuted, -2, 2) to the native predecision log odds. Also measure native + empty, native + verified, native + permuted, raw-return controller, native and terminal PPO. A constant shift matched on the evaluated span distribution uses no outcomes. Store choice probabilities, per-question F1, actual endpoint costs and the six inference costs. One forward pass may use all six votes; report cost explicitly.
decision: Require at least 90 percent of the 209 registered later questions, four histories with positive focal gain over native, a nonempty strictly prospective panel, a +0.02 overall gain over both native and terminal, a positive gain over semantic-only, permuted, raw-return and matched-rate, and improved prospective F1 versus native before independent development. The 91 and 209 questions remain training-history diagnostics. The original independent complete LoCoMo and LongMemEval-S tests remain locked.
inspiration: Zheng et al., Judging LLM-as-a-Judge with MT-Bench and Chatbot Arena, NeurIPS 2023. Swapping option order checks position sensitivity. Here the LLM supplies a pre-write decision and only measured reader F1 scores outcomes.
